title: Dinosaur with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="30" ry="22" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="20" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="45" rx="13" ry="8" fill="#81C784"/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="44" r="1.5" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="44" r="1.5" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M42 49 Q50 54 58 49" stroke="#2E7D32" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Eye whites -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="34" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="34" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Eye iris -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="34" r="4" fill="#1B5E20"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="34" r="4" fill="#1B5E20"/>
  <!-- Eye pupils -->
  <circle cx="41.5" cy="34" r="2" fill="#0D3B0F"/>
  <circle cx="61.5" cy="34" r="2" fill="#0D3B0F"/>
  <!-- Sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx="39.5" cy="32" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="59.5" cy="32" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="36" r="0.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="36" r="0.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Sparkle rays left eye -->
  <line x1="34" y1="28" x2="31" y2="25" stroke="#FFEB3B" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="33" y1="34" x2="29" y2="34" stroke="#FFEB3B" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="40" x2="32" y2="43" stroke="#FFEB3B" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Sparkle rays right eye -->
  <line x1="66" y1="28" x2="69" y2="25" stroke="#FFEB3B" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="67" y1="34" x2="71" y2="34" stroke="#FFEB3B" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="65" y1="40" x2="68" y2="43" stroke="#FFEB3B" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Sparkle stars -->
  <polygon points="46,26 47,29 50,29 47.5,31 48.5,34 46,32 43.5,34 44.5,31 42,29 45,29" fill="#FFEB3B"/>
  <polygon points="56,28 57,31 60,31 57.5,33 58.5,36 56,34 53.5,36 54.5,33 52,31 55,31" fill="#FFEB3B"/>
  <!-- Spikes on back -->
  <polygon points="50,18 46,26 54,26" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <polygon points="42,22 38,30 46,28" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <polygon points="58,22 62,30 54,28" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M78 70 Q90 65 92 55 Q94 65 85 72 Z" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <!-- Tail spikes -->
  <polygon points="85,58 82,52 88,54" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <polygon points="89,62 87,56 93,58" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  <!-- Arms -->
  <path d="M28 62 Q20 58 18 52" stroke="#4CAF50" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M72 62 Q80 58 82 52" stroke="#4CAF50" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Claws -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="51" r="2" fill="#81C784"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="51" r="2" fill="#81C784"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="35" y="84" width="10" height="10" rx="4" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <rect x="55" y="84" width="10" height="10" rx="4" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="94" rx="9" ry="4" fill="#388E3C"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="94" rx="9" ry="4" fill="#388E3C"/>
  <!-- Toe claws -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="93" r="1.5" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="96" r="1.5" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="93" r="1.5" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="93" r="1.5" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="96" r="1.5" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="93" r="1.5" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="42" r="3" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="42" r="3" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
